node.label: Elevated urine N-acetylaspartic acid level
node.definition: The amount of N-acetylaspartate in the urine, when corrected for urine concentration, is above upper limit of normal. This feature can be measured using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry.

evidence.snippet: Severe Canavan disease: Elevated urine N-acetylaspartic acid level (frequency HP:0040281) [TAS]
Elevated urine N-acetylaspartic acid level — Very frequent (99-80%)
